content:
巨型自然增补：

**本模组为你的世界增添了众多巨型自然物体，从参天大树、巨型蘑菇到超大型仙人掌和树桩等独特结构，应有尽有。**

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b077412616702e609ce2f6015d8832b27c346045.jpeg)

**它整合了我之前所有以“巨型”为主题的模组，将它们融合成一个完整包。**

本模组包含以下结构：
<details>
<summary>点击展开</summary>

巨型松树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-pine-tree

巨型下界树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-nether-tree

巨型冰刺 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-ice-spike

巨型丛林树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-jungle-tree

巨型橡树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-oak-tree

巨型樱花盆栽树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-cherry-blossom-bonsai-tree

巨型竹子 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-bamboo

巨型枯橡树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-dead-oak-tree

巨型雪树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-snowy-tree

巨型红蘑菇 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-red-mushroom

巨型棕榈树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-palm-tree

巨型仙人掌 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-cactus

巨型棕蘑菇 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-brown-mushroom

巨型黄树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-yellow-tree

巨型树桩 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-tree-stump

巨型沼泽树 https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/giant-swamp-tree

</details>

![总览](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1048090222233565447da3c4d52646dd63628ca4.jpeg)

- 结构周围的地形经过精心设计，以自然融入对应的生物群系。

![总览](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75c01849025542f902bc59a2b6ce207323c598e4.jpeg)

- 这些巨型结构也是建造基地的绝佳地点！

![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ed0874af82733606659b7c9152732d9038150e6.jpeg)

欢迎在你的整合包中使用本模组。
